classifications.SAFE_TEMPLATE: Structurally bounded neutral high-confidence text/Greek research template with no detected false-certainty distractor risk. Still not a product card or ranking authorization.
classifications.NEEDS_REWRITE: A structurally linked prototype contains a distractor certainty/evidence-laundering risk or other wording/alignment issue that prevents use as a product template without editorial rewrite.
classifications.COURSE_POSITION_ONLY: Effective candidate is project-position material, visibly remains project-position, and has no higher-precedence rewrite/reject defect.
classifications.NONCOMPETITIVE_ONLY: Authority is contested, interpretive, historical, application/intertext/lexical/text-critical, medium confidence, or READY_NONCOMPETITIVE, with no higher-precedence rewrite/reject defect.
classifications.REJECT_AS_PRODUCT_TEMPLATE: Orphan/invalid/HOLD/unresolvable evidence-owner or structurally corrupt template.

checks: candidate_id resolves after the complete candidate override chain
prototype reference equals effective candidate reference
prototype source contract resolves only through effective candidate source_minimum
source ownership is bound to source_minimum field provenance, not merely latest candidate override
project position is not relabeled neutral
Research noncompetitive state is not upgraded
wrong answer options are scanned for false-certainty and evidence-laundering language
automated keyed-answer/effective-claim lexical alignment signal is recorded for human audit
correct-index distribution remains 16/16/16/16 but can never override semantic/evidence defects
rule: Classification is recomputed from the exact effective Research authority and prototype content by scripts/validate_product_handoff.py. Older Wave3j/Wave3m self-audits and answer-position balancing are historical inputs, not current product approval.
